git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 94bca5f - feat: Add progressive image fetching to plan and review commands
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Commit 94bca5f added Step 14a/3a image fetching but placed it OUTSIDE the INNER loop, before user confirmation. This caused images to be fetched on every day presentation iteration, wasting time if user requested changes (fetch → modify → re-fetch pattern).
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Moved image fetching INSIDE the INNER loop as a substep of Option 1 processing ('This day is perfect'). Now images fetch ONCE per confirmed day, AFTER user confirms perfect but BEFORE exiting loop to next day. Pattern: present day → user confirms → fetch images → set day_confirmed_perfect=true → exit loop → next day.
